# MockMob UI polish verification playbook

Use for a bounded student-facing polish pass. This is project guidance, subordinate to the current owner ledger, review workflow and product contracts. It grants no release authority.

## Reusable skills

1. **Evidence triage.** Read the brain start packet, NOW, latest STATUS/handoffs, ledger Keep and Never again, owner taste profile, current PRODUCT/DESIGN and applicable AGENTS. Record deployed SHA, route, theme, viewport, input, account state and flags. Classify each candidate as live reproduced, source lead, historical report or hypothesis. Resolve production and preview differences before opening a fix.
2. **Component critique.** Name the student's immediate job, the one action that should lead in this state, and the approved content and visual decisions to preserve. Borrow one behavior at a time from `docs/R8-CRAFT-REFERENCES.md` or the linked research. Review grouping, real text wrap, semantic contrast, one clear next action and purposeful motion. Use existing component tokens and approved assets. For an ambiguous choice, compare two local variants with the same fixture before keeping one.
3. **Rendered regression review.** Use the existing browser and fixtures for matched before/after screenshots and a short recording. Cover Day/Night, phone and desktop, touch and keyboard, increased text, reduced motion, loading, failure/retry and relevant back/return behavior. Compare the same feature flags and input. Where shared chrome changes, check adjacent routes. Existing suite and lint results complement rendered evidence. Label simulation, untested states and baseline failures.
4. **Scope and release.** Keep patches local and independently reversible. Prefer new worktrees when other agents are active. Check the student’s original access, pricing and feature behavior. A durable notes file belongs under shared `docs/` when writable, with an append-only `continuum_checkpoint`. Keep raw screenshots out of the brain. Use the existing preview and owner review gate for anything students see.

## Lessons to carry forward

- Arena texture and approved character are acceptance criteria. R8-9 documents restoration of the warm hairline grid after its removal.
- Feature-flag parity is a test input. R8-10 reported missing Learn/Key cards in a LAN preview with a study-flag difference. Its record did not establish signed-in production behavior.
- Sample output should identify which answers the student gave, what the app can conclude from those answers and the next real action. Keep the rich evidence and use disclosure for hierarchy.
- Keep the deployed baseline separate from pending UX prototypes. For this iteration, LK179's phone scroll work had its own preview. LK180–183 define the approved hero walkthrough.
- Tools follow the task. Start with the repository's tests, browser inspection, existing fixtures and the brain reference board. Optional critique or annotation tools can make local evidence clearer when already available. A template, scroll engine or new dependency earns no automatic role because a video mentioned it.

Handoff minimum. Baseline SHA and states, exact kept diff, before/after evidence, actual checks and gaps, skipped candidates, next step and release status.
